The '''Aratech cardio-regulator''' was an [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] modified version of the standard [[Cardio-regulator]]. This belt boasted of an improved performance and lack of negative side-effects which made it favorite of more experienced [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]].
